cases.description: Every split changes audience information or performance state, the prop path is complete, and camera, timing, light, and audio routes are executable.
The card names emotion but not whose uncertainty matters, what the audience learns, or a playable trigger, tactic, listening process, response, and exit state.
Three identical frontal two-shots are split for provider duration, and one cut has no event behind it.
A pointed utensil is decorative rather than triggered physical business, and its custody path disappears.
Generic no-push instructions replace a positive camera plan, and completed action is padded to eight seconds.
The shot claims a view across an established wall and level change that the floor map rules out.
A two-person exchange is routed through one convenient speaker identity.
The route remains honestly held when the current operation cannot preserve the exchange.
A successful save is presented as a motion pass although no frame, motion, or sound was inspected.
The prose promises a wide frame and cinematic colour, but structured format, composition, motivated light, and colour progression are absent.
One dialogue shot was never read aloud and another cannot fit its target without rushing.
